model: Sum of parts: owner-FCF DCF of the operating content/streaming/games business plus haircut investment book (engine route)

inputs.share_count_basis: 16,800.6m issued at 30 Jun 2026 less 255.0m treasury shares bought back May-Jun 2026 for cancellation (H1 FY2026 interim Note 14). Share options anti-dilutive. Both convertible bonds are deep out of the money (conversion HK$2.704 and HK$2.60 vs HK$1.51) and are carried as debt at redemption value, not as shares. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. The company is a serial equity issuer (9,175m shares FY2021 -> 16,801m FY2025, placings and consideration shares); that issuance bought investment assets now in the bridge, and future raises are a stated risk, not modelled.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, statement of changes in equity / Note 21 share-based compensation RMB50.317m; no cash tax on equity awards disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0). H1 FY2026 SBC RMB14.5m.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. 1 CNY = 1.1721 HKD, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-10 03:38Z. Parity check: inverse HKDCNY=X 0.8513 -> 1.1747 (0.2% tie); cross via USDCNY=X 6.683 and HKD peg ~7.83 -> 1.172. All per-share values computed in RMB then multiplied by 1.1721; unsuffixed values are HKD. Rate is not refreshed by refresh_price.py.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:05Z regular close (HKEX), Yahoo Finance chart API
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB flows, so an RMB build: China 10y CGB ~1.8%, China ERP ~6.5%, levered beta ~1.3 for a hit-driven content/games producer -> CoE ~10.3%; rounded to 10.5% and used as WACC because the group is net cash. Same WACC in all three scenarios: risk (hit dependence, Tencent customer concentration, governance) is charged once, in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B): lease cash (FY2025 principal RMB35.1m plus interest) deducted in the flows via lease_cost_pct_path; EBITDA is IFRS-16 (adds back right-of-use depreciation); da_pct excludes right-of-use depreciation; lease liabilities (RMB55.9m) EXCLUDED from total_debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is a negative RMB30.0m deficit with a small loss share (H1 FY2026 -6.8m); immaterial, ignored in both flows and bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: sum of parts, routed per dcf-methods SKILL.md 'straddles two rows' rule (operating company + holdco investment book), following the 0087.HK Swire precedent of a NAV discount on the holdco assets. (1) Operating business (film/TV content production, Pumpkin Films streaming, Jingxiu games) valued by the owner-FCF component engine on operating economics ONLY: EBITDA is defined as operating profit EXCLUDING 'Other gains - net' (fair-value marks, dividend income) plus SBC, PPE, right-of-use and other-intangible D&A. Film-rights amortisation is NOT added back -- it is the content cost, and content spend runs through OCF. FY0 anchors: FY2025 operating profit ex other gains 376.4 (1,658.1 - 1,281.7), EBITDA so defined 501.1 = 15.0% of revenue; FY2024 1,409 (38%); H1 FY2026 164.7 on 1,183 (13.9%); H2 FY2025 was loss-making ex gains, so TTM to Jun-2026 operating EBITDA is about nil. (2) Investment book (FVTPL 11,210.8, equity-method associates 2,283.3, FVOCI 0.5 at 30 Jun 2026) enters via equity_bridge at haircut values by fair-value level, and its income (fair-value gains, dividends, share of associates' profit, finance income) is excluded from the flows -- matching-asset rule. (3) Cash 5,438.0 less borrowings 463.5 and convertible bonds at redemption value (HK$2,341m 2030 CB + HK$2,524m x 101.51% 2027 CB = HK$4,903.1m = RMB4,183.2m at 1.1721) gives net cash 791.5. The 2027 CB (RMB~2.19bn) matures 31 Jan 2027 and must be redeemed from cash or refinanced. Buybacks: RMB319.8m in H1 FY2026 (first ever), so the flat count is partly funded this year but the long-run record is net issuance. last_fcf = reported FCF 557.2 - SBC 50.3 - finance income 214.9 = 292.0 (FY2025). Other receivables/loans to third parties (RMB1,146m) and the 563m film-investor funds are treated as operating working capital and excluded from the bridge.
inputs.investment_book_detail: 30 Jun 2026 FVTPL by level: L1 listed equity 77.6 (+FVOCI listed fund 0.5); L2 2,391.5 (unlisted companies 2,009.6, unlisted funds 355.9, bonds 25.9); L3 8,741.7 (unlisted funds 8,322.6, unlisted companies 303.8, film rights investments 115.4). Level-3 unlisted funds rose from 859m (FY2024) to 4,606m (FY2025) to 8,323m (H1 FY2026), funded by equity placings and CBs; valued on market multiples / administrator statements. H1 FY2026 FVTPL turnover: 14.7bn additions, 11.7bn disposals (mostly listed equities).

equity_bridge.item: Level-1 listed equities + FVOCI listed fund at market (0% haircut)
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim fair-value hierarchy table; 77.6 + 0.5

equity_bridge.item: Level-2 FVTPL (unlisted companies, funds, bonds) at 20% haircut
Level-3 FVTPL (mainly unlisted funds) at 45% haircut

2,283.3 x 0.70; mostly recent purchases (Beijing Yonghang 30%, Xiaozhi 45%, Kabum 7.4%) at cost plus share of profit

equity_bridge.item: Acquisition consideration payable (related-party 660 + unlisted investee 33 + contingent 377)
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 Note 19 and balance sheet; debt-like claims arising from the investment programme

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue path (FY2025 3,343 -> FY2035 ~4,600); every historical CAGR is distorted by the 2021 restructuring, M&A and share issuance
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (44%/82%) diverges far more than 30% from revenue and EPS CAGRs: equity growth is placings, CBs' equity component and consideration shares, not retained earnings. FY2020 EPS (RMB0.001) makes the 5-year EPS CAGR meaningless. Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - interest income) was negative in FY2020-22 (-250.9, -1,861, -468.1) and 308.4/322.0/292.0 in FY2023-25, so FCF CAGRs are undefined; owner FCF has been flat to down while SBC-free reported FCF rose, the gap being growing finance income on raised cash.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (RMB m): FY2023 308.4, FY2024 322.0, FY2025 292.0. Reported operating profit includes Other gains - net of +362/+1,031/+239/-1,222/+1,282 in FY2021-25; ex those, operating profit was 605/-147/743/1,287/376 and H1 FY2026 98.8.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 ~2,540 = H1 actual 1,183 + H2 ~1,360 (Middle East film co-production, drama releases, Ragnarok/CookieRun launches if licensed); FY2027 +18% as the EA/Tencent-framework game slate lands; then fades to 3%.
base.margin_rationale: FY2026 12% (H1 13.9%, H2 2025 negative); recovery to 22% by FY2030, below the FY2023-24 average of ~31% and above FY2025's 15%.
base.wc_rationale: Negative capture: film rights (3.4bn) and trade receivables (2.7bn, >1 year of TTM revenue) dwarf payables; growth consumes cash.

scenario_narratives.base: H1 FY2026's 46% revenue drop is mostly timing: the 2026 film slate (Pegasus 3, Scare Out, Once Upon a Time in the Middle East) and drama releases restore FY2026 revenue to ~RMB2.5bn, and the game pipeline (EA FC Theater end-2026, Red Alert: Glory and Project LORD 2027, CookieRun/Sanguo once version numbers are granted, 12 titles under the 2026 Tencent framework) lifts FY2027 18%. Operating EBITDA (ex fair-value marks) recovers to 22%, short of the FY2024 peak, as Red Alert Online ages and Pumpkin Films' AI short drama remains sub-scale. The investment book is worth roughly 60% of carrying value; net cash covers the January 2027 CB redemption.
scenario_narratives.bull: The licensed-IP game slate hits (EA, Ubisoft, Devsisters, Krafton, Pokemon, Tencent framework), turning Jingxiu into a multi-title publisher and pushing revenue past RMB5bn by FY2029 with 28% operating EBITDA margins; AI production tooling cuts content costs and Tencent remains a reliable distributor and buyer. Box office normalises after H1 2026's -40.6%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Content stays hit-or-miss after the H1 2026 box-office slump, game launches slip or fail version-number approval, Red Alert Online decays, and Tencent-related customers (43% of FY2025 revenue) reprice or cut volumes. Revenue resets ~30% to ~RMB2.3bn and grows with inflation at 15% margins, while receivables over a year of revenue keep absorbing cash. The investment-book haircut in the bridge is common to all scenarios, so a further mark-down of the Level-3 funds would be additional downside beyond this case.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: hit-driven content with H1 FY2026 revenue -46%, 43% of revenue from Tencent-related customers, VIE-held licences, a history of serial dilution and a related-party-heavy Level-3 investment book. Base 50% as the H1 drop is largely slate timing. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent game launches, each gated by regulatory version numbers, to succeed together.

valuation_philosophy.summary: China Ruyi is two things: a mid-sized, hit-driven Chinese content and games operator, and an RMB13.5bn investment book funded largely by equity placings and convertible bonds. Reported profit is dominated by fair-value marks (+1,282m FY2025, -1,222m FY2024), so the operating business is valued on operating cash economics alone and the investment book is added at haircut values by fair-value level (blended ~38% discount, matching holdco precedent). Net cash, net of the CBs at redemption value, is added and acquisition payables deducted.
key_risks_to_valuation: Level-3 unlisted-fund marks (RMB8.3bn) are unobservable and connected to the controlling shareholder's ecosystem; the bridge haircut is the largest single judgment in the valuation
Further equity placings or CB conversions dilute the flat share count; the company has nearly doubled its share count since FY2021
HK$2.52bn zero-coupon CB matures 31 Jan 2027 and must be redeemed from cash or refinanced
Tencent customer concentration (43% of FY2025 revenue) and VIE licence structure
Game launches gated by PRC version-number approval; film revenue gated by box office
Trade receivables of RMB2.7bn exceed TTM revenue; collection risk sits in the working-capital driver
CNY/HKD rate is a static input and is not refreshed by price updates
